title: Angles on a straight line and around a point
examples: Why do angles on a straight line add to 180?
What do angles around a point add up to?
How do I find a missing angle on a line?

explain.say: Look at the clock. At 3 o'clock the hands make a square corner. That is a right angle: 90 degrees. An angle tells you how far something turns.

draw.text: Angles on a straight line and around a point

explain.say: Now it is 6 o'clock. The hands point opposite ways and make a straight line. That is two right angles, so 180 degrees. Angles on a straight line always add up to 180.
If a straight line is split into two angles, they share the 180. Look: 110 plus 70 makes 180. If one angle is 130, what is the other?

items.label: Together 180°
items.ask: Why do angles on a straight line add to 180?

explain.say: It is 50! Now picture the minute hand going all the way round, from 12 back to 12. That is a full turn: 360 degrees. So angles around a point always add up to 360.

Well done! Cut a round roti into 3 equal pieces from the middle. Each angle is 360 divided by 3, which is 120 degrees. Wow: we probably use 360 thanks to the ancient Babylonians, who counted in 60s. Challenge: what angle if you cut 8 equal pieces?

faq.q: Why do angles on a straight line add to 180?
faq.a: A straight line is half a full turn. A full turn is 360 degrees, so half of it is 180.

faq.q: Why do angles around a point add to 360?
faq.a: Going all the way round a point is one full turn, and a full turn is 360 degrees.
A right angle is a quarter turn, 90 degrees, like the corner of a book or the hands at 3 o'clock.
asks: How many degrees in a right angle?

faq.q: How do you find a missing angle on a straight line?
faq.a: Take the angles you know away from 180. If one angle is 130, the other is 180 minus 130, which is 50 degrees.
asks: Missing angle on a straight line

faq.q: Why are there 360 degrees in a circle?
faq.a: Nobody knows for sure. A popular idea is that ancient Babylonians counted in 60s, and 360 is close to the number of days in a year and divides evenly in many ways.

facts: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°, and angles around a point add up to 360°.
360 can be divided exactly by 24 different whole numbers, including 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 12.

quiz.say: Two angles sit on a straight line. One is 65 degrees. What is the other?

wrong.1: 25 comes from taking 65 away from 90, a right angle.
wrong.2: 295 uses 360, which is for a full turn.

quiz.say: Four equal angles fit around a point. How big is each one?

wrong.2: 180 would only fit two angles round a point.
